SCFG1.label: Funding / Awarded Grants Data

SCFG1.1.label: Funding Text Correction
SCFG1.1.description: Definition: The funding text on a document record is missing, wrong or needs updating.

SCFG1.2.label: Funding Number Correction
SCFG1.2.description: Definition: The grant or funding number on a record is missing or wrong.

SCFG1.3.label: Funding Sponsor Correction
SCFG1.3.description: Definition: The funding sponsor name on a record is missing, wrong or needs standardising.

SCFG1.4.label: Missing Awarded Grant
SCFG1.4.description: Definition: An awarded grant is not shown in Scopus and the customer asks for it to be added.

SCFG1.5.label: Awarded Grant Correction / Removal
SCFG1.5.description: Definition: An existing awarded grant record needs correcting or removing.

SCFG1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Funding / Awarded Grants Data'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Funding / Awarded Grants Data' means: Definition: Corrections to funding text, funding numbers or sponsors on document records, and requests to add, correct or remove awarded grants.
